title: Hölder's inequality for the exponents $4/3$ and $4$
statement:
Let $f, g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be Boolean functions, and take all expectations with respect to the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$. Then their $L^2$ inner product satisfies
\[
  \langle f, g \rangle
  \;\le\;
  \bigl(\E[\,\abs{f}^{4/3}\,]\bigr)^{3/4}\,
  \bigl(\E[\,\abs{g}^{4}\,]\bigr)^{1/4}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f, g are Boolean functions of arity n
replaced:
For Boolean functions $f, g$,
\[
  \langle f, g \rangle
  \le \bigl(\E[\,\abs{f}^{4/3}\,]\bigr)^{3/4}\,\bigl(\E[\,\abs{g}^{4}\,]\bigr)^{1/4}.
\]
